title: Mar Zutra Zuta
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: Hyman quotes Yuchasin: “Mar Zutra Zuta expounded in the name of Mar Zutra Rabbah, and the Rabbis said it before Rav Papa.” Seder HaDorot wrote, “I have not found it.” Hyman points out that Seder HaDorot itself cites it in the previous line, under the entry Mar Zutra Rabbah, from Shabbat 50a and Beitzah 8a. He suggests that Yuchasin either had this reading, or called him “Zuta” because he expounded in the name of Mar Zutra Rabbah; therefore Yuchasin does not cite Mar Zutra Rabbah as a separate entry, and Hyman considers Seder HaDorot’s division into two needless.

notes.text: The consulted Shabbat 50a has Mar Zutra expounding in Mar Zutra Rabbah’s name, without Zuta in that occurrence. Hyman’s Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot reports and his explanation of the two entries remain his bibliographical argument.
